Nell: Quick note 
We're proposing a small routing-hygiene pass: reconcile tag aliases and normalize playbook weights so mid-risk accounts aren't double-nudged. Planning dry-run Wed 9am PT. Who can run selector and sanity-check samples? :clipboard:

Omar: I can run selector. Proposed rules: normalize tags (case, synonyms), collapse duplicate playbook triggers by weight, and prefer renewal_nudge > account_owner_nudge when renewal_date < 21d. Sample 200 accounts.

Zoe: Add guard: exclude accounts with escalation = true and exclude trial accounts. Also write results to a sandbox table `cs_playbook_sandbox` and mark `visibility = cs_ui` only.

Kai: For UI, show `would_fire` array and `preferred_playbook` string. Do NOT change canonical playbook wiring yet. Also rate-limit notifications to owners: max 2/day increase.

Omar: SQL I'll run (short):
```sql
SELECT account_id, tags, health_score, renewal_date, would_fire
FROM cs_playbook_sim
WHERE health_score BETWEEN 30 AND 65
  AND escalation = false
LIMIT 200;
```

ops-bot: scheduled job 'routing-hygiene-dryrun' queued for 2025-07-08T16:00:00Z by user Nell

Zoe: I'll draft console tooltip: "Preferred playbook is a non-destructive suggestion to reduce duplicate nudges. Approve to commit changes." Put runbook link in Confluence when ready.

Nell: Plan: run sample -> quick 9:15am PT review -> canary 50 -> validate 1h -> roll to 200 if green. Omar upload sample CSV to /shared/cs/routing-hygiene/samples/rg_sample_1743219991.csv and tag high-confidence rows. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
